title: readContractCatalog
responsibility: Reads and validates the current nested unit registry into sorted query records, optionally attaching stored scenario states.

inputs.name: readContractCatalog.root
inputs.description: Project root whose specification/units JSON documents are loaded and schema-validated; source is never listed or read.

inputs.name: readContractCatalog.includeStates
inputs.description: When true, also attach stored scenario state declarations; false avoids scenario reads for list and map queries.

outputs.name: readContractCatalog
outputs.description: Records sorted by id, each with its validated manifest, current contract file path, primary owned path or runtime fallback and optional declared states; duplicate ids fail.

errors.name: Filesystem rejection
errors.description: Original Node filesystem error while listing a specification directory, except ENOENT which is treated as empty. The original code and message are preserved.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: A unit JSON document is unreadable, invalid or duplicates another unit id; optional scenario loading can also fail validation.
